verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal docs confirm a built-in simulated card reader and reader simulator for developing/testing without physical hardware, and Stripe's broader test-mode/sandbox concept (API keys, test data) is implied but not explicitly detailed for Terminal beyond hardware simulation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full sandbox/test-mode environment covering data isolation (test vs live API keys), independent hands-on confirmation of sandbox fidelity for AI-driven testing, and any AI-native tooling specifically validating sandbox use.
